description: This file defines a SwiftUI component 'ScreenWebView' that embeds a WKWebView using UIViewRepresentable, along with a coordinator class 'ScreenWebViewCoordinator' that manages the WebView's lifecycle, configuration, and navigation delegate. It handles deep link interception, UI message handling, and WebView setup for displaying web content within a SwiftUI app.

classes.name: ScreenWebView
classes.description: A SwiftUI wrapper for WKWebView that manages its creation, updating, and dismantling process.

classes.name: ScreenWebViewCoordinator
classes.description: Manages the WKWebView instance, including configuration, navigation, message handling, and cleanup.

classes.name: ScreenNavigationDelegate
classes.description: Handles WKWebView navigation policies, specifically intercepting custom deep links with scheme 'openclaw'.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: Handles JavaScript messages sent from WKWebView to trigger actions in the native app, specifically 'openclawCanvasA2UIAction'.

methods.name: makeContainerView
methods.description: Creates and configures the container UIView and embedded WKWebView, sets constraints, and attaches the WebView to the controller.

methods.name: updateController
methods.description: Updates the controller reference and reattaches/detaches WebView as needed.

methods.name: teardown
methods.description: Cleans up references and removes message handlers for deinitialization.

methods.name: makeWebView
methods.description: Configures and creates a WKWebView instance with non-persistent data store and specific appearance settings.

methods.name: installA2UIHandlers
methods.description: Registers message handlers for JavaScript communication from the WebView content.
